Surface precedence under conflict (mean ranks, Bradley-Terry); failure decomposition by rule demand and family; per-surface and per-family accuracy; test-retest ICC; judge agreement

Automatic: deterministic checks (regex, AST, cross-file, command-output) for 13.3% of verdicts; GPT-5.2 LLM judge (3-vote majority, temperature 0.3) for rubric and hybrid (86.8% of rows). Behavioral prior labels from zero-injection probes on 9 builds plus curation. Item-clustered bootstrap; crossed bootstrap for E0

fields.v: Benchmark run: 60 items x 12 models x 3 rounds; rules assigned to admissible surfaces (descriptive, not paired). E0: counterbalanced AB/BA conflict runs moving opposite rules across surfaces, fixed task, deterministic scoring, 458 runs per direction. Baseline: zero-injection runs (rule withheld) to label priors. Held constant: items, rules, judge. Acceptance: scoring scripts + judge. Repetitions: 3 rounds. Human intervention: none

Acc 72.1-85.9%, AP-Acc 66.1-78.6%; every model worse on against-prior rules by 3.6-7.4 pts (mean 5.81; 13.09 on deterministic subset), positive for all on common support with item-clustered CIs (lower bounds +1.06 to +4.83). Prior control keeps top build, swaps 3 adjacent rank pairs; adjacent ranks not resolved. Failures: shortfall 77.1%; output control lowest family (70.9%). E0: SP, PF, UI ahead of TD and SD (ordering in 9,652/10,000 bootstrap resamples)

Partly: separates against-prior from aggregate compliance consistently and shows shared difficulty ordering (r 0.57-0.89); does not resolve adjacent models. Repeatability: ICC 0.725 (agent), 0.599 (cell); cell-level round range 15.6 pts. Judge swap to Claude Opus 4.7 gives 62.1% agreement (kappa 0.163), the dominant uncertainty; human audit 69.0% (kappa 0.515) on a related configuration

Claims hold for this panel of items and models; items selected for discriminativeness (selection optimism); AP-Acc is behavioral stratification, prior-label probe cohort overlaps evaluated models; LLM judge labels shift under judge swap; main panel surfaces not counterbalanced; E0 is pooled tendency on 4 synthetic conflicts, 9 older builds, AB run before BA

Release planned (rule library YAML, 60 items, scoring scripts, 2,160-record verdict panel, analysis code; Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0); location 'given in a later version'; raw traces excluded. No pre-registration. Languages: multiple (not itemised). Authors from ByteDance Seed evaluate ByteDance's Seed-2.0-Pro.
